children: Producer prices in Sweden increased 6.8% year-on-year in August 2026, accelerating from 6.4% in July and marking the sixth consecutive monthly rise.
The increase was mainly driven by higher energy prices (25.2% vs 26.0% in July).
Meanwhile, prices for capital goods rose at the same pace (1.6%), while the decline in consumer goods prices eased (-1.6% vs -1.7%).
Excluding energy-related products, producer prices rose by 3.9%, accelerating from a 3.5% gain in the previous month.

On a monthly basis, producer prices rose by 0.9% in August, following a 0.1% rise in July. “Higher prices for refined petroleum products, as well as trade services in electricity, accounted for the largest contributions to the positive monthly change in the producer price index in August,” said Maria Bäckström, price statistician at Statistics Sweden

title: Swedish Producer Inflation Accelerates in August
